title: An epimorphism of abelian sheaves on a site is locally surjective (and conversely)
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ a morphism in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ of abelian sheaves on $\mathcal C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Then $\varphi$ is an epimorphism of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ if and only if it is locally surjective: for every object $U$ of $\mathcal C$ and every $h\in\mathcal H(U)$ there are a covering $\{V_j\to U\}_{j\in J}$ of $U$ in $\mathcal C$ and sections $g_j\in\mathcal G(V_j)$ with $\varphi_{V_j}(g_j)=h|_{V_j}$ for all $j\in J$. (General-site version of [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-sheaf-epi-locally-surjective], which is stated for the small etale site.)

mathlib_match.how: specializes in one line, plus one lemma for the covering form. Setting as recorded on lem-weil-pbc-site-sheaves-enough-injectives: C a SmallCategory, the coverings of the site form a Precoverage K (K U = the presieves Presieve.ofArrows of the covering families of U; multiplicities and the index set are invisible to a presieve), J = K.toGrothendieck (= K.toCoverage.toGrothendieck by Precoverage.toGrothendieck_toCoverage, Coverage.lean:383), Ab(C) = Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat. Then isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' (EpiMono.lean:124) gives IsLocallySurjective φ ↔ Epi φ, where IsLocallySurjective φ (LocallySurjective.lean:94) says that the image sieve {V → U : h|_V ∈ im φ_V} (imageSieve, :49) of every h ∈ H(U) is J-covering. By Precoverage.mem_toGrothendieck_iff_of_isStableUnderComposition (Sites/PrecoverageToGrothendieck.lean:166) a sieve is J-covering iff it contains a covering family of the site, which is the node's form (a covering family inside the image sieve gives the lifts g_j; conversely the family with lifts lies in the image sieve). Its hypotheses are the site axioms: HasIsos K by axiom (i); IsStableUnderComposition K by axiom (ii); HasPullbacks K and IsStableUnderBaseChange K by axiom (iii), the latter for any choice of fibre products because a family {P_i → V} isomorphic over V to {U_i ×_U V → V} is a covering by (i) and (ii) (compose with the single isomorphisms P_i → U_i ×_U V). Instances for A = AddCommGrpCat: HasSheafify J A for a small site (Sites/LeftExact.lean:308); HasSheafCompose (forget A) from hasSheafCompose_of_preservesLimitsOfSize (Sites/Whiskering.lean:161); Balanced (Sheaf J A) as Sheaf J A is abelian (sheafIsAbelian, Sites/Abelian.lean:40; balanced_of_strongEpiCategory, Limits/Shapes/StrongEpi.lean:158); HasFunctorialSurjectiveInjectiveFactorization A from ConcreteCategory/EpiMono.lean:148; WEqualsLocallyBijective from the instance at Sites/LocallyBijective.lean:153 (with PreservesSheafification J (forget A) from Sites/PreservesSheafification.lean:298). The source repository applies this lemma with A = AddCommGrpCat on sites (WeilConjectures/Topology/Sheaves/CechCriterion.lean:77, CategoryTheory/Sites/Torsor.lean:310).
